voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Gumalaw ang takip ng kawayan. Mula sa loob.
lines.beat_before: hook: macro on the bamboo tube; its cork lifts and jiggles; antennae in the gap

lines.text: Sa Siquijor, may lumang paniniwala sa barang. Mga insektong ikinukulong sa kawayan, at pinapadala sa isang pangalan.
lines.beat_before: the table: the beetle crawls out over the cork, past the paper with a name

lines.text: Biyernes Santo. Tahimik ang mga kampana.
lines.beat_before: the window sill: the island at dusk, the church bell hanging still; the beetle opens its wings

lines.text: Lilipad ito nang mababa. Sa daan, sa baryo, sa ilalim ng pinto.
lines.beat_before: the flight: low over the road, between the houses, to the lit gap under a door
his sleeping face, huge; the beetle lands by his ear and crawls behind it

lines.text: Kinabukasan, hindi na siya makatayo. May gumagalaw sa ilalim ng balat niya.
lines.beat_before: morning: his forearm on the banig; something moves under the skin

lines.text: Pero karamihan sa mga mananambal ng Siquijor, nanggagamot. Tuwing Sabado de Gloria, nagluluto sila ng gamot sa bundok.
lines.beat_before: the mountain at golden hour: the healers' cauldron, herbs, smoke

lines.text: Kapag tama ang gamot, lalabas din ito.
lines.beat_before: the bottle to his mouth; silence; a tiny click of wings from inside him
